text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Sweep Tosho and I take
a small
detour on the way home...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! Look over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Sweep Tosho's gaze to a large
Siberian
husky lying in front of a rice
field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He looks fairly old, yet dignified like a

wolf—albeit one wearing a collar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right?! His fur is so beautiful, and his
eyes are
such a deep color...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That settles it! I'm making him my
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That unusual appearance says a lot
about him. He
was sent here by a sage
to protect this land a
long time ago!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's take him back to the dorm! First
thing I'll do
is give him a bath!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dog clearly belongs to someone
else, but
Sweep Tosho is quite
enamored with it. I need to
put a stop to
this without ruining it for her...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 他の使い魔が妬いちゃうかも？
本人を説得できたら考えてみよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho already has a lot of stuffed
animal
familiars. Hopefully I can use her
affection toward
them to distract her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, but...
choice_data_list: 一旦帰って、他の子の意見も聞こう

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the master here. I make the
decisions!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if the others feel
jealous, so long
as—
choice_data_list: そうかもしれないけど……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
Oh, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You just want all my commands to be for
you,
don't you? That's why you don't
want any more
familiars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I forgot I'm considered one
of her
familiars too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I figured as much!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Really! What am I gonna do with you?!
Talking
back just 'cause you're lonely...
Can you even call
yourself a real
familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it'd be a pain if my familiars
started
fighting! I'll give up on this one
for you, so you
better be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, I want you to be my legs!
Gimme a
piggyback ride!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so surprised! I just lost my
chance to
ride a huge dog because of
you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now, crouch down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! You're too shaky, I'm starting
to feel
sick! Let me down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In exchange for giving up the dog, I do
my best
to fulfill my role as her familiar
as we head home.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then I'll bring him back for sure!
I'm really
good at convincing people!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Sweep Tosho's attempt at
persuasion with
my heart racing
anxiously.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, doggy! I've got some great news
for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna let you be my familiar! How
does that
sound?! Pretty awesome,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you ignoring me?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What the heck?! You get to work for me!
Aren't
you happy?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Say something at least! I'll take a woof
or even a
meow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dog suddenly looks behind him.
There's a
Shiba Inu slowly approaching
that looks even
older than he is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He silently watches the dog's shaky
steps. It must
live in the same
neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, never mind! I don't need him
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I said I don't need him, didn't I?!
Besides! If you
get a good look at him,
he's all wrinkly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
He can just play around with his friend
forever for
all I care!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like I care. They can do whatever they
want!
choice_data_list: ……あの子たち、ずっと一緒だといいな
……あの子たち、ずっと一緒だといいね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever she says, Sweep Tosho gives a
warm
smile and walks away looking
content.
